when is the first drop?

Fall/Winter 2026 drop dates will be announced in news and to the mailing list first.

how do I buy a piece?

Pieces are sold through this shop on drop day. Prices marked TBD have not been released yet.

Join the mailing list — restocks and store news go there first.

privacy

This shop does not run accounts or checkout yet. The mailing list signup is confirmed on this page only, and contact messages open in your own email app.

accessibility

Live In Love aims to keep this shop simple, readable and usable for everyone. If something on this site is hard to use, reach out through the contact page.
